name: Zettai Zecchou ☆ Seiki no Daihatsumei!! -Otome o Nerau Gakuen Dougu Tahatsu Ero-
original_name: ぜったい絶頂☆性器の大発明!! ―処女を狙う学園道具多発エロ―
source:
Since childhood, Kyouya Daiguuji showed an almost supernatural talent as inventor, but everyone sees him as an eccentric gymnastics buff instead.
Bullied and/or ignored by his (female) schoolmates, and more than a little envious of the popularity his father (the school principal and the protagonist of the prequel) enjoys, Kyouya finally blews up and founds the secret "2nd Division of Science Club".
Under the guise of Commander Dark and with the help of his inventions and (duped) minions, Kyouya starts a one-man war against his tormentors, and only total subjugation of all the (females in the) school will be enough for his hurt ego!!
translation:
大宫司峡哉从小便展现出近乎超自然的发明才能，但大家只把他视为古怪的体操狂热者。

他受到女同学欺负或无视，也十分嫉妒作为校长、同时也是前作主人公的父亲备受欢迎；峡哉终于爆发，成立秘密的“科学部第二部”。
他以“暗黑司令”的身份，在发明品与受骗部下的帮助下，向折磨自己的人发动一人战争；只有让学校里的所有女性彻底屈服，才能满足他受伤的自尊！
